g.text: Quiet local and larger-input probes | 12 fresh-process samples per source/input
Medians and interquartile ranges; these probes are separate from the full calibration.
Regex: serial below 65,536 cleaned bytes. Mandelbrot: serial below N=256; at most six 16-row batches.
CPU means user plus system time, including worker threads. Canonical-size timing remains unrun.
